purpose: One saved game/party state: current historical frame, current game time, global hidden state and summaries.
Player character profile and mutable body/knowledge/inventory state.
Materialized or changed graph nodes in a party. Canonical nodes are referenced by ID, but party state owns changes.
Mutable routes and links in the current party: opened, blocked, changed, or discovered edges.
Materialized places in the party, canonical or LLM-created with approved cause.
Exact scenic zones inside a location.
Scene anchor points: door, chest, cart, well, fire, gate.
Current technical position: region -> place -> location -> minilocation -> scene anchor, plus last route.
Map knowledge of a character, separate from factual party graph.
Travel history and consequences for movement.
Materialized NPCs and groups with profile depth: background, scene, key.
Materialized significant items and containers. Player request never creates items without causal basis.
Inventory/access index for carried or controlled items; separates owner from physical holder.
Materialized historical/local/deferred events and consequences in the current party.
Processed player turns: input, intent, time cost, visible result and hidden updates.
Party memory: important facts, rumors, obligations, discoveries and visible history.
LLM step provenance: generated content, validation status, repair lineage. Does not expose hidden prompts to player UI.
Structured validation/audit issues found during generation, import, or turn processing.
